items.headline: Holman and Harris combine for 3 TDs as Wyoming downs Hawaii 27-10
items.description: — Markell Holman rushed for 87 yards and two touchdowns, and Samuel Harris added 94 yards and a score as Wyoming beat Hawaii 27-10 on Saturday in its Mountain West opener.

items.headline: Wyoming hosts Hawaii in MWC matchup
items.description: Hawaii (1-2) at Wyoming (1-2), Sept. 26 at 3 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: QB Angel Flores leads the way on the ground and Central Michigan tops Wyoming 24-10
items.description: — Quarterback Angel Flores ran for 163 yards with two scores, Central Michigan churned out 339 yards rushing and the Chippewas defeated Wyoming 24-10 on Saturday.
